basis: Illustration contact bands at1.8m mannequin scale, reused from existing project checks; not exact collision, contact pressure or clinical certification.

palm_L.rationale: Actual palmar/heel skin, independently from the fingers; natural palm arch remains visible.
palm_L.selection: Local original floor-facing skin faces within5mm of the lowest face centroid in the declared anatomical search region; frozen source vertex IDs.

thumb_pad_L.rationale: Actual distal thumb pad skin; both hands and all ten digits are checked individually.
